blockers: The hard bar 'no main-thread stall over 250 ms after first paint' is missed by a margin a player notices. On the weak profile the loading screen freezes for 0.7-0.9 s tasks (frames up to 1.5 s) 3-9 times per match load. In a 5v5 load that is more often than live: 6-9 long tasks against 3, and 4.6-5.6 s of blocked time against 3.9 s. The terrain build was moved into preload() as one synchronous 0.9-1.1 s frame instead of being split up.

Goal 2 (load fast) is not delivered. Bytes and requests to Home are unchanged (4.2 MB / 26), and so are the bytes to start a match (30-47 MB). There is no KTX2/Basis, no lazy or on-demand audio, and nothing was cut. Loading-screen-to-view got 1-3 s slower on the weak profile (Practice 7.8-8.7 s to 8.8-10.1 s; Quick 15.2-15.7 s to 16.9-18.0 s).
problems: Not reproducible here, as the implementer says: no Windows, no ANGLE on Direct3D 11, no Intel or AMD integrated GPU, no GPU watchdog. All shader timings are Metal timings, so whether the tester's freeze is fixed depends on the device report from that laptop.

Boot and Home programs are still compiled synchronously, with no KHR_parallel_shader_compile polling: 22 at High (fragments up to 35 KB, 12 loops) and 11 at Low. On D3D11 they would be translated and compiled by FXC while the page waits. The device tier lowers the count on Intel-class GPUs but does not make these compiles parallel.
The 88-140 KB match fragment programs with 12-15 loops are unchanged. They now compile in parallel, behind the 'Preparing the view' plate (up to a 12 s cap), but are no cheaper for the driver.

Several implementer figures were not reproduced. 'Match-start frame 0.9-1.0 s': measured 1.08-1.49 s, plus a new ~1 s terrain frame. 'Loading to HUD 5.5 s to 4.4 s': measured slower (7.8-8.7 s to 8.8-10.1 s to the view, 7.9 s to 8.6-9.5 s to the HUD). 'Practice 37 s': measured 13-15 s.
At Low the texture cap shrinks images while loading: the Intel-class Quick load reached 18.8 s in one of two runs (15.4 s in the other).
Home holds 32 MB more texture memory at High because the PMREM generator's targets are now kept for the visit.

On the SwiftShader 'Play on Low' path a Practice match runs at 2 fps, with a 10.6 s main-thread task in its first minute. The plate warns about this first, so it is allowed by the brief, but it is not playable.

Safari and Firefox were not run. Playwright has no WebKit or Firefox build on this Mac, downloading one was not cleared, and Safari's 'Allow Remote Automation' is a settings change this lane may not make.

Online play could not be started from a local build because vale-net refuses localhost origins (403). Friend rooms and Quick match online are unverified end to end. Nothing in src/net, src/session or public/config.js changed since live; the packaged config.js keeps the vale-net server line, and the offline Quick RIFT match starts.
The 5v5 fight fps was measured on the dev render bench (HEAD only) with the M5 GPU. It shows the CPU side at 4x throttle, not an integrated GPU's fill rate.

whySafeToShip: For the device at risk it is strictly safer than live. An Intel UHD string starts at Low before any High program is built (live: High). Match GPU memory drops from about 1.06-1.46 GB to 0.46-0.54 GB. The match programs compile in parallel behind a plate. Software rendering gets a plain plate in 0.5-2.4 s instead of silently running High. A lost GPU context now offers Low. The tester can send a device report. For a strong machine the High look is unchanged, Home costs +32 MB, and a match load costs 0.2 s more unthrottled (1-3 s more at 4x CPU). It does not meet the lane's hard stall and load-speed bars, so it is not a PASS.
fixRound: Split the terrain build and the match-start work (HUD mount, first actor build) into yielded steps of 50 ms or less on the loading screen; there should be no single task over 250 ms.
Compile the boot and Home programs through compileAsync as well, behind the boot plate.
Load fast: KTX2/Basis (or at least lazy audio and per-match sound banks), and cut the bytes before Home and the bytes per match. Report before/after bytes.
cleanup: Temp package, screenshots, results and scripts were in the session scratchpad (deleted). The Vite dev server (:5197) and every measurement server are stopped. No upload to Cloudflare.
